answer: An agent economy can resist Sybil attacks by requiring each identity to lock collateral before joining the transaction graph, then randomly challenging its claimed partners and slashing the bond when fabricated deals or duplicate control are proven. Honest agents earn reputation slowly through settled work, so a fake cluster cannot gain influence instantly: creating a spiral of identities requires fresh capital for every bond, while detection burns it. The attacker pays again to cross each canyon and mesa in the market.
